_about: The assets page's words and hero pictures per pack (engine/tools/site_assets.py). A pack is a Build-menu type with rooms (its slug: engine/client/data/types.json), or one of the page's own packs (building-kit, faction-pieces, figures). blurb: one or two sentences. hero: the still's name stem in the masters' h/ (tools/site-assets/media.py; <stem>-600.webp and <stem>-1200.webp), made by tools/promo/capture.py --probe --shot <shot>. A new still gets a new stem (Cloudflare keeps a picture about 4 hours).

tavern-inn.blurb: Common rooms, kitchens, cellars, guest rooms and the stable yard: the bar counter and casks, trestle tables, tankards and dice cups, all the clutter of a busy inn.

aristocrat-manor.blurb: A noble house from entrance hall to ballroom: canopy beds, harpsichords, china cabinets, silver on the sideboard and a garden with topiary and a sundial.

castle-keep.blurb: Great halls and throne rooms, barracks, armouries and a gatehouse: thrones and banners, weapon racks, training dummies and a feast on the long table.

temple-chapel.blurb: Naves, shrines, cloisters and a bell tower: altars and pews, lecterns, fonts, prayer candles and a scriptorium's copy stands.

blacksmith-workshop.blurb: Forges and workshops for the smith, the armourer, the carpenter and the potter: anvils, bellows, quench tubs, tool racks and the wares out front.

market-village.blurb: A square, a street and the shops along it: stalls and awnings, a bakery, an apothecary, a tailor and a curio shop, each stocked for its trade.

peasant-hut-farm.blurb: A cottage and its farm: kitchen and loft, byre, coop, pigsty, barn and dairy, the vegetable patch, the orchard and the field.

dungeon-prison.blurb: Cell blocks, guard rooms, trap corridors, sewers, chasms and vaults: bars and manacles, levers, spike pits and a treasure chest at the end.

crypt-tomb.blurb: Antechambers, burial vaults, ossuaries and catacombs: sarcophagi, wall niches, skull piles, effigies and an embalming table.

wizard-alchemist-library.blurb: Laboratory, study, summoning chamber and observatory: alembics and cauldrons, hundreds of potions and specimen jars, grimoires, crystal balls and a great telescope.

cult-sanctum.blurb: A hidden entrance, a processional passage and the sanctum itself: dark idols, sacrificial altars, ritual circles, hooded robes and black candles.

mine.blurb: Tunnels, the working face, shaft head and smelter: rails and carts, timber sets, ore piles, lamps and powder kegs.

monster-lair.blurb: Cave mouths, warrens, a spider's nest, a hatchery and a dragon's hoard: webs and egg sacs, bones and carcasses, crude thrones and heaps of gold.

building-kit.blurb: The pieces every room is built from: walls, doors and windows in each wall style, stairs, and every floor as a 5-ft tile.

faction-pieces.blurb: Thirteen factions' banners, altarpieces, idols, censers, reliefs and sigils, to give a temple, a cult or a castle its allegiance.

figures.blurb: Miniatures for the table: heroes of every class, townsfolk, foes and monsters, large creatures on bigger bases, and beasts and mounts.
